messages.subject: error in dataProcess: (sum(run.missing < 0.25) !=0) missing value where TRUE/FALSE needed
parts:
I'm trying to run dataProcess on my SRM data: 

srm.nonorm<-dataProcess(input_ms, normalization=F, fillIncompleteRows=T)

I'm not sure why I keep on getting an error. I've tried changing Intensity NAs to 0 and changing Truncated NAs to FALSE. 

 Summary of Missingness :


  # transitions are completely missing in at least one of the conditions : 485


    -> DIPVPKPK_2_y4_1, DIPVPKPK_2_y5_1, DIPVPKPK_2_y6_1, DIPVPKPK_2_y6_2, ELASGLSFPVGFK_2_y10_1 ...


  # run with 75% missing observations: NA


Error in if (sum(run.missing < 0.25) != 0) { : 

  missing value where TRUE/FALSE needed


I've attached a screenshot of the head of my file since I think that is easier to see than if I copy if over.


Thank you,

Emma

messages.author: bc13a282f8b0c08b
messages.subject: Re: error in dataProcess: (sum(run.missing < 0.25) !=0) missing value where TRUE/FALSE needed
parts:
Hi,


I looked at your data. MSstats assumes, that there two labels for each feature: L and H (or light/heavy). However, in your data each feature only has a single label. That is the source of the error.
Btw for Skyline input, you should use the censoredInt="0" option in dataProcess - only this way missing values will be handled correctly.


Kind regards,
Mateusz Staniak
